words.ex: The company paid for advertising on TV and billboards to tell people about its new shoes.

words.ex: The three-month campaign used posters, videos and events to get people talking about the new drink.

words.ex: A news story from an honest reporter has more credibility than an ad the company paid for.

words.vi: tích hợp, kết hợp nhiều phương pháp

words.ex: The marketing team studies what customers want and then finds ways to sell the product to them.

words.ex: Email is one method of reaching customers; a phone call is another.
